package.name: Slurp 2
package.description: The Slurp remaster, installable beside the original Slurp with its own separate data: create a local Creator profile from an Engine character or persona, publish public or locked posts, and simulate subscriptions and audience activity. Install it, restart Marinara Engine when prompted, then open Home → Slurp 2.
